decision.reason: [ev-3bbda3954fcf] says only that the operator's permissions to emit Kubernetes events were fixed. It does not say what goes wrong in an environment without the fixed permissions. The chart renders [ev-e59f6c1596ce] [ev-25cf4daec27b] [ev-f8233e3fcf69] [ev-be3ca9c6446f] show that events.k8s.io/events create and patch were added on top of core/events:create, which suggests the operator now emits events through the events.k8s.io API. If so, installs with custom or non-chart RBAC that lack this permission may fail to emit events, so "none" could hide a real permission-lost or behavior-change consequence. To decide, we need the content of PR #8077 (which API group and verbs the operator now needs, and what happens when they are missing).
